description: This Java class defines a ProductEntity that extends the Product class and implements Serializable. It encapsulates product-related data such as price, quantity, SKU, dimensions, weight, ratings, availability, and shipping details, with associated getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProductEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing a product entity used for data transfer and persistence, extending a base Product class and serializable for storage or network transfer.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the product's price as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product.

methods.name: getSku
methods.description: Returns the Stock Keeping Unit identifier.

methods.name: isProductShipeable
methods.description: Returns whether the product is shippable.

methods.name: isProductIsFree
methods.description: Returns whether the product is free.

methods.name: setProductIsFree
methods.description: Sets whether the product is free.

methods.name: setQuantityOrderMaximum
methods.description: Sets the maximum quantity allowed per order.

methods.name: getQuantityOrderMaximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum quantity allowed per order.

methods.name: setProductVirtual
methods.description: Sets whether the product is virtual.

methods.name: isProductVirtual
methods.description: Returns whether the product is virtual.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether the product is available.

methods.name: setDateAvailable
methods.description: Sets the date when the product becomes available.

methods.name: getDateAvailable
methods.description: Returns the date when the product becomes available.

methods.name: setQuantityOrderMinimum
methods.description: Sets the minimum quantity per order.

methods.name: getQuantityOrderMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum quantity per order.

methods.name: setRatingCount
methods.description: Sets the count of ratings received.
